H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1288: to kneel; by implication to bless God (as an act of adoration), and (vice-versa) man (as a benefit); also (by euphemism) to curse (God or the king, as treason)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H3925: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H676: something to sieze with, i.e. a finger; by analogy, a toe
H4421: a battle (i.e. the engagement); generally, war (i.e. warfare)
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H4686: a net, or (abstractly) capture; also a fastness
H4869: defence, high fort (tower), refuge, Misgab, a place in Moab
H6403: to slip out, i.e. escape; causatively, to deliver
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H7286: to tread in pieces, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer, or (specifically) to overlay
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H8478: the bottom (as depressed); only adverbially, below (often with prepositional prefix underneath), in lieu of, etc.
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H120: ruddy i.e. a human being (an individual or the species, mankind, etc.)
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H582: a man in general (singly or collectively)
H2803: properly, to plait or interpenetrate, i.e. (literally) to weave or (generally) to fabricate; figuratively, to plot or contrive (usually in a malicious sense); hence (from the mental effort) to think, regard, value, compute
H1892: emptiness or vanity; figuratively, something transitory and unsatisfactory; often used as an adverb
H1819: to compare; by implication, to resemble, liken, consider
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H5674: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
H5186: to stretch or spread out; by implication, to bend away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of application
H8064: the sky (as aloft; the dual perhaps alluding to the visible arch in which the clouds move, as well as to the higher ether where the celestial bodies revolve)
H3381: to descend (literally, to go downwards; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively, to fall); causatively, to bring down (in all the above applications)
H5060: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6225: to smoke, whether literal or figurative
H1300: lightning; by analogy, a gleam; concretely, a flashing sword
H6327: to dash in pieces, literally or figuratively (especially to disperse)
H7971: to send away, for, or out (in a great variety of applications)
H2671: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H2000: properly, to put in commotion; by implication, to disturb, drive, destroy
H4791: altitude, i.e. concretely (an elevated place), abstractly (elevation, figuratively (elation), or adverbially (aloft)
H6475: to rend, i.e. open (especially the mouth)
H5337: to snatch away, whether in a good or a bad sense
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H5236: foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H6310: the mouth (as the means of blowing), whether literal or figurative (particularly speech); specifically edge, portion or side; adverbially (with preposition) according to
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H7723: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H8267: an untruth; by implication, a sham (often adverbial)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H5035: a skin-bag for liquids (from collapsing when empty); hence, a vase (as similar in shape when full); also a lyre (as having a body of like form)
H6218: ten; by abbreviated form ten strings, and so a decachord
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H8668: rescue (literal or figurative, persons, national or spiritual)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H2719: drought; also a cutting instrument (from its destructive effect), as a knife, sword, or other sharp implement
H7451: bad or (as noun) evil (natural or moral)
H1431: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H2106: an angle (as projecting), i.e. (by implication) a corner-column (or anta)
H8403: structure; by implication, a model, resemblance
H1964: a large public building, such as a palace or temple
H4392: full (literally or figuratively) or filling (literally); also (concretely) fulness; adverbially, fully
H6329: to issue, i.e. furnish; causatively, to secure; figuratively, to succeed
H2177: properly, nourished (or fully developed), i.e. a form or sort
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H6629: a collective name for a flock (of sheep or goats); also figuratively (of men)
H7231: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
H2351: properly, separate by awall, i.e. outside, outdoors
H441: familiar; a friend, also gentle; hence, a bullock (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a cow); and so, a chieftain (as notable, like neat cattle)
H5445: to carry (literally or figuratively), or (reflexively) be burdensome; specifically, to be gravid
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3318: to go (causatively, bring) out, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, direct and proxim.
H7339: a width, i.e. (concretely) avenue or area
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H3602: just so, referring to the previous or following context
